gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Last year' fixes past simple passive: were + conducted for the plural subject.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.

gaps.sentence: The debt ___ (repay) in full by May, he promised.
gaps.explanation: Reported future passive: would be + past participle after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: The novel ___ (write) in under three months.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive (was/were + past participle): was written. The writer is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the incident until the inquiry began.
gaps.explanation: Nothing was known by anybody: past simple passive was + known.

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: The suspect is believed ___ the country weeks ago.
gaps.explanation: Believe + to-infinitive; 'weeks ago' demands the perfect infinitive to have left.

gaps.sentence: By next June, the entire collection ___ (move) to the new wing.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect passive: will have been + past participle for something finished by 'next June'.
